symptom: Narration text is clipped off the LEFT edge of the screen. In didyouevendoanything.p2s the longest line "No one was in sight. Not" loses its leading "N" (rendered leftmost pixel is at screenshot x=0). Shorter lines render fine: "wind." appears centered at internal x~124. thefog.p2s is identical: "A heavy fog had settled" is clipped, "streets." renders fine. The wider the line, the further off-left it starts.
root_cause: Narration is PER-LINE CENTER-ANCHORED, not left-flushed. Each line's draw origin = box_center - line_width/2. The narration box width is desc[0x1c]=313, so box_center = 156.5 internal px (= screen center). For any line whose proportional width exceeds ~313px (or whose half-width exceeds the center), origin goes NEGATIVE and the first glyph is drawn off-screen to the left. This is a per-line ORIGIN bug, NOT a wrap/length bug. Patch 23 (li a0,8 @0x308328) only pinned the 0x1cc pen to constant 8 -- a contributor swamped by the center math -- so it neither removed the centering nor established a left margin; the measured center shows no +8 offset, consistent with the user's report that Patch 23 made it worse / did not fix it.
evidence: didyouevendoanything narration decoded from descriptor 0x1137ac0, glyph stream ptr +0x04 = 0x011e0aa2 (BIG-ENDIAN cells, gid=char-32): 'No one was in sight. Not' / 'a sound, not even the' / 'wind.'

fix_hypothesis: Make narration LEFT-FLUSH instead of center-anchored. The on-screen origin = box_center(156.5) - line_width/2; the architect must kill the -width/2 term and set origin to a fixed left margin (e.g. ~8px box-left). Patch 23's 0x1cc=8 is the wrong contributor -- the dominant centering enters via the count/width half-width subtraction that feeds the line origin (the glyph-count loop @0x3082A0 plus the align!=1 block @0x308308 and/or sp+0x130=count*12 @0x3083B4). Patch the narration origin computation to a constant left margin (remove the half-width subtraction) rather than nudging 0x1cc. Alternative if centering must be preserved for short lines: clamp origin = max(left_margin, box_center - width/2) so wide lines left-flush while short lines remain centered. Either way, since the render is now proportional (Patch 14) but the centering pre-measure historically used count*12 (monospace), the safest fix is to abandon centering for narration and left-flush, which also resolves the build-side wrap mismatch.
